![What is Product-Market Fit? - Ann Arbor SPARK](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-3c3e4bdabed4:4)
Product-market fit (PMF) means `being in a good market with a product that can satisfy that market, resulting in organic growth, high usage, and strong customer retention`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Product%E2%80%93market_fit)[[2]](https://a16z.com/12-things-about-product-market-fit/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVjZn9mk67c/)

### What Is Product-Market Fit?

- **Core Definition:** Popularized by investor Marc Andreessen based on concepts from Andy Rachleff, PMF happens when target customers buy, use, and tell others about a product fast enough to sustain growth and profitability.[[1]](https://www.productplan.com/glossary/product-market-fit)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Product%E2%80%93market_fit)
- **Market First:** As articulated by [Andreessen Horowitz](https://a16z.com/12-things-about-product-market-fit/) , a great market pulls a product out of a startup, while a great team in a bad market will fail.[[1]](https://a16z.com/12-things-about-product-market-fit/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/hayleyleibson/2018/01/18/how-to-achieve-product-market-fit/)
- **Not a One-Time Event:** PMF is an ongoing process of adaptation as markets, competitors, and customer needs shift.[[1]](https://a16z.com/12-things-about-product-market-fit/)

### Key Signs of Product-Market Fit

- **Organic Growth:** Customers find the product naturally through word-of-mouth rather than heavy, forced advertising.
- **High Retention and Low Churn:** Users stick around instead of leaving quickly (e.g., software churn rates dropping to low single digits).
- **The Sean Ellis 40% Rule:** Over 40% of surveyed users state they would be "very disappointed" if they could no longer use the product.
- **High Demand:** The team struggles to keep up with customer orders, usage spikes, or inbound requests.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/sales/product-market-fit/)[[2]](https://a16z.com/12-things-about-product-market-fit/)[[3]](https://stripe.com/resources/more/what-is-product-market-fit-what-startups-need-to-know)[[4]](https://innovationlabs.harvard.edu/how-to/find-pmf)[[5]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/customer-journey/product-market-fit/)[[6]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/hayleyleibson/2018/01/18/how-to-achieve-product-market-fit/)

### How to Measure PMF

- **Quantitative Metrics:** Track cohort retention rates, Net Promoter Score (NPS), active user growth, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
- **Qualitative Feedback:** Conduct direct customer interviews to see if users view the product as a necessity rather than a nice-to-have.
- **Milestone Benchmarks:** For B2B products, this often means having at least 6 active, referenceable customers per vertical market.[[1]](https://www.svpg.com/product-market-fit/)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/product-market-fit)[[3]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/customer-journey/product-market-fit/)[[4]](https://stripe.com/resources/more/what-is-product-market-fit-what-startups-need-to-know)[[5]](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/sales/product-market-fit/)[[6]](https://innovationlabs.harvard.edu/how-to/find-pmf)

### Steps to Achieve PMF

1. **Identify Target Customers:** Define a specific audience or "hell yes" customer profile with an urgent, painful problem.
2. **Build an MVP:** Create a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) containing just enough features to test your core value proposition.
3. **Test and Iterate:** Launch to early alpha/beta users, gather feedback, and continuously refine the product or pivot your messaging.[[1]](https://leanstartup.co/resources/articles/a-playbook-for-achieving-product-market-fit/)[[2]](https://innovationlabs.harvard.edu/how-to/find-pmf)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Product%E2%80%93market_fit)[[4]](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/sales/product-market-fit/)

If you are working on a specific product, tell me:

- **Who** your target customer is
- **What** problem you are trying to solve
- **How** users are currently reacting to your product

I can help you outline a plan to test and improve your market fit.
